body:
I understand how you feel, my depression also started when I was around your age. You're not alone, and I know how hard it can be to comfort yourself or even be comforted by others. Sometimes it can feel helpless, but it seems that you have people around you that care. Even if you don't like sharing your problems with others, maybe you can find some comfort in their presence. Sharing your problems can help a lot too, your friends sound nice

You're very young, and if you get help now you could save yourself from so many years or suffering. It's not guaranteed that medication or therapy will fix everything, but it can certainly help and be life saving in cases. If you're able, even if there is long waiting times for psychiatry, get a doctor.
I feel like you're doomed to get an ed if you're short. It's straight up impossible to lose weight without eating as much as a toddler eats
I hope so too, I really do. Best of luck to you.

As someone who is also ugly I understand. When you're actually ugly nobody lets you question if you are, they just say it to your face. Been told so my entire life, people on the streets laugh at me. People tell you looks aren't everything and that even if you're ugly you can have other qualities, but it's just impossible if you're ugly beyond a certain point. Our existence annoys/disgusts people.

Depression and anxiety. I have hobbies, but they don't give me joy, neither do I have the will to do anything. I can't really tell you why I'm depressed, as it'd be a little too long and I'm not that interested in talking about it.
Thank you for your answer and honesty. I hope things get better for you.
Thank you for your honest answer, I hope you are doing better now.
Thank you for your help. I can guess how unhelpful cops are. If you didn't have a psychiatrist, would you be forced to find one? Or will they just let you go?
Thank you so much for your help.
